description: This file defines the LauncherActivity class, which is responsible for launching the main activity of the app, potentially showing a welcome screen based on some conditions. It manages flow control in the app startup sequence, including checking build config flags and displaying a 'What’s New' screen if appropriate.

classes.name: LauncherActivity
classes.description: Activity that manages the initial launch sequence of the app, showing a welcome screen if new content is available or proceeding directly to main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the default onCreate method; checks build configuration, determines whether to show a welcome screen, and navigates to main activity accordingly.

methods.name: proceedToMainActivity
methods.description: Starts the MainActivity and finishes the launcher activity.
